Usage: scip-typescript index [options] [projects...]

Options:
  --cwd <path>                  the working directory (default:
                                "/home/runner/work/cli-modfence/cli-modfence")
  --pnpm-workspaces             whether to index all pnpm workspaces (default:
                                false)
  --yarn-workspaces             whether to index all yarn workspaces (default:
                                false)
  --yarn-berry-workspaces       (deprecated) use --yarn-workspaces instead
                                (default: false)
  --infer-tsconfig              whether to infer the tsconfig.json file, if it's
                                missing (default: false)
  --output <path>               path to the output file (default: "index.scip")
  --progress-bar                whether to enable a rich progress bar
  --no-progress-bar             whether to disable the rich progress bar
  --no-global-caches            whether to disable global caches between
                                TypeScript projects
  --max-file-byte-size <value>  skip files that have a larger byte size than the
                                provided value. Supported formats: 1kb, 1mb,
                                1gb. (default: "1mb")
  -h, --help                    display help for command
